newsitem.title: USA: Liberty Property files $850 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Liberty Property files $850 mln shelf.

text.p: Liberty Property Trust filed Friday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $850 million in common and preferred shares of beneficial interest and debt securities.
The registration also covers depositary shares and warrants.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate business purposes, including the acquisition of properities or other assets, the filing said.
Based in Malvern, Penn., Liberty Property is an owner and operator of suburban industrial and office real estate in the United States.
